name: Abner
bio: Abner was the son of Ner, Saul's cousin, and the commander of Saul's army. Scripture first introduces him while listing Saul's household and officials (1 Samuel 14:50). The full story of Abner — installing Saul's son Ish-Bosheth as king after Saul's death, waging a long war against David's forces, finally turning to support David, and ultimately being assassinated by Joab — unfolds in detail through the rest of 1 and 2 Samuel.
